architectureReview: Candidate dispatch reads each living owner/window from actual registered MatchSkillBindingIndex shards. It does not iterate the complete skill catalog on every card.
Remaining seven Skills.Values scans are cached nullable booleans, at most once per engine/flag.

Whole-catalog ProgramDependencies flags can still enable unnecessary history/fact capture. No measured hot-path percentage was established; fixed transitive closure is a possible later change, not implemented in this batch.
Restore reuses the supplied frozen registry. Command preparation freezes only pending events; it does not repeatedly freeze the full committed journal. Full history JSON comparison is test work.
Complex legacy nested-damage macros retain their existing owned-return checks; this review does not claim complete migration of the long list.

PrepareBorrowedOperationProbe.ps1
probeSources.source:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$workspace = 'C:\Users\17917\Desktop\Card'
$probeDirectory = $PSScriptRoot
$sourceRows = @()
foreach ($entry in @(
    @('tests/CardGame.Core.Tests/Fame2017WuXianChecks.cs','WuXianOperationDiagnostic.cs','Fame2017WuXianChecks','WuXianOperationDiagnostic'),
    @('tests/CardGame.Core.Tests/Fame2017PublicPileChecks.cs','PublicPileOperationDiagnostic.cs','Fame2017PublicPileChecks','PublicPileOperationDiagnostic'),
    @('tests/Shared/BorrowedSwordScenario.cs','BorrowedScenarioOperationDiagnostic.cs','BorrowedSwordScenario','BorrowedScenarioOperationDiagnostic')
)) {
    $original = Join-Path $workspace $entry[0]
    $sourceRows += @{ path=$original; sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $original).Hash }
    $body = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($original).Replace($entry[2],$entry[3])
    $body = $body.Replace('game.Submit(', 'BorrowedProbeMeter.Submit(game,')
    $body = $body.Replace('game.GetHumanLegalActions()', 'BorrowedProbeMeter.Actions(game)')
    foreach ($variable in @('game','copy','replay')) {
        $body = $body.Replace("$variable.CreateSnapshot(", "BorrowedProbeMeter.Snapshot($variable,")
    }
    $body = $body.Replace('SnapshotJson.Serialize(', 'BorrowedProbeMeter.SnapshotSerialize(')
    $body = $body.Replace('JsonSerializer.Serialize(', 'BorrowedProbeMeter.Json(')
    $body = $body.Replace('CommandJson.Serialize(', 'BorrowedProbeMeter.CommandsEncode(')
    $body = $body.Replace('CommandJson.Deserialize(', 'BorrowedProbeMeter.CommandsDecode(')
    $body = $body.Replace('game.CreateCheckpoint()', 'BorrowedProbeMeter.Checkpoint(game)')
    $body = $body.Replace('GameCheckpointJson.Serialize(', 'BorrowedProbeMeter.CheckpointEncode(')
    $body = $body.Replace('GameCheckpointJson.Deserialize(', 'BorrowedProbeMeter.CheckpointDecode(')
    $body = $body.Replace('GameReplay.Restore(', 'BorrowedProbeMeter.Restore(')
    if ($entry[2] -eq 'Fame2017WuXianChecks') {
        $needle = 'Replay(game,registry);Play(game,action);'
        $index = $body.IndexOf($needle, [StringComparison]::Ordinal)
        if ($index -lt 0) { throw 'Borrowed begin marker changed.' }
        $body = $body.Substring(0,$index) + 'Replay(game,registry);var actual = BorrowedProbeMeter.BeginActual(game,converted,count);Play(game,action);' + $body.Substring($index+$needle.Length)
        $needle = 'var use=game.ResolutionStack.OfType<CardUseFrame>().Single(f=>f.CardId==action.CardId && f.CardKind==CardKind.BorrowedSword);'
        $body = $body.Replace($needle,'actual.Pause();'+$needle)
        $needle = 'Replay(game,registry);RejectUnknown(game);Answer(game,c=>c.Parameters.GetValueOrDefault("option-id")=="continue");'
        $body = $body.Replace($needle,'Replay(game,registry);RejectUnknown(game);actual.Resume();Answer(game,c=>c.Parameters.GetValueOrDefault("option-id")=="continue");')
        $needle = 'var results=game.Events.Select(e=>e.Payload).OfType<BorrowedSwordResolvedEvent>().Where(e=>e.ResolutionId==use.Id).ToArray();'
        $body = $body.Replace($needle,'actual.Finish(game,use.Id);'+$needle)
        $body = $body.Replace('{ var replay = BorrowedProbeMeter.Restore(', '{ using var replayScope = BorrowedProbeMeter.Begin("ReplayWrapper"); var replay = BorrowedProbeMeter.Restore(')
        $body = $body.Replace('Require(State(game).Equals(State(replay)),', 'using var comparisonScope = BorrowedProbeMeter.Begin("ReplayComparison"); Require(State(game).Equals(State(replay)),')
        $body = $body.Replace('{ var before = State(game); var p = Prompt(game)!;', '{ using var rejectScope = BorrowedProbeMeter.Begin("RejectUnknown"); var before = State(game); var p = Prompt(game)!;')
    }
    if ($entry[2] -eq 'Fame2017PublicPileChecks') {
        $body = [regex]::Replace($body,'(private static void Replay\(GameEngine game,ContentRegistry registry\)\s*\{)', '$1' + "`n        using var replayScope = BorrowedProbeMeter.Begin(`"ReplayWrapper`");")
        $body = $body.Replace('Require(Enumerable.Range(0,4).All(seat=>BorrowedProbeMeter.SnapshotSerialize(', 'using var comparisonScope = BorrowedProbeMeter.Begin("ReplayComparison"); Require(Enumerable.Range(0,4).All(seat=>BorrowedProbeMeter.SnapshotSerialize(')
    }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $probeDirectory $entry[1]),$body)
}
$sourceRows | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $probeDirectory 'borrowed-operation-source-hashes.json') -Encoding utf8
Write-Output 'Diagnostic copies prepared. Originals unchanged.'
